body:
Joe ran a multi-node audit in ~/ai/aida-multinode (report: docs/UPSTREAM-REPORT.md there). Baseline 0.16.0 failed 2 and warned 3 of 12 strict scenarios. Antigravity wrote fixes on branch fix/multinode-sync-bugs (6 commits, 318 lines, 7 behind main, untested by our CI). I filed drafts:
- Mechanical, recommend APPROVE, codex lanes cherry-picking from the branch: BUG-2609 (rebase under GIT_EDITOR=false, false FF conflict banner, stale cache after db sync; high), BUG-2611 (init writes global Codex/Antigravity MCP config without --with-mcp; high), BUG-2610 (edit history misses scalar/tag changes), BUG-2612 (glab JSON error hidden; low).
- Your ruling needed (tagged needs:advisor-ruling): BUG-2613 merge_spec_upstream scalar 3-way merge semantics; BUG-2614 default_author honouring AIDA_USER, which on this machine is often a seat handle (BUG-2524); BUG-2615 deriving mail recipients from store authorship + mailbox publish on db sync --push.
- SPIKE-715 aida-store-sync crate: architecture, sketch first; recommend park behind the crate-split line.
Product order once approved: 2609, 2611 into the next free lanes after STORY-2844.
subject: Product intake: multi-node audit, 8 drafts for disposition (BUG-2609..2615, SPIKE-715)
